governance.statement: This protocol is self-governed and has not been externally independently reviewed. Results under it are reproducible automated evidence, not independent confirmation.
governance.relationToForgeWorldContract: Separate. The frozen Forge World sealed-qualification proposal (V3, 320a07da) stays inactive and is not completed, replaced or relabeled by this benchmark.

protocol.scientificQuestion: Do existing Sentinel experts improve decisions and gameplay outcomes over the strongest native controllers under identical public information and legal actions?

CALIBRATION.use: variance description and runtime budgeting only; cannot change any N, margin or hypothesis

strata.use: factory only: native MIRROR layout reflection (family string contains MIRROR)

STRUCTURAL_OOD.limitation: Only factory has a native structural generator variation (MIRROR layout). The sensor strata are native observation-channel shifts, not structural composition shifts; they are labeled as such.

seedRule.derivation: seed_i = base + i, 0 <= i < count (consecutive inside a 0x80000-wide namespace)

protocol.samplingUnit: One world = (game, tier, seed, family, sensor). All arms are evaluated on every scheduled world (paired). Worlds are never replaced.
protocol.levels: All 24 ADVANCED_1..3 levels (catalog ASCII_WORLDS_3_2_EXTENSION_V1); equal weight per tier within a game; games are never pooled.

NEXUS_REPAIR_OVER_STRONGEST_V1.source: this file; v31 publicGraph + nexus-selector-v1-port, unchanged

SHADOW_SENTINEL_READONLY.source: strongest native + v31 nativeEvidence-equivalent advisory calls

protocol.eligibility: Every scheduled world is eligible. Exclusion only for an invalid status (illegal action, null action, policy exception, state mutation, replay failure) of any arm on that world; the world is excluded from that comparison for all arms, counted, never replaced.

normalizedRegret.reason: No native counterfactual evaluator or optimal-value oracle in the v32 ASCII kernels; constructive witnesses are existence proofs only

integrityControls: SHADOW_SENTINEL_READONLY trajectory IDENTICAL to STRONGEST_NATIVE on 100% of worlds
SENTINEL_V31_AS_IS IDENTICAL to V31_FALLBACK_ABLATION on every world where Nexus never fires, and on 100% of rescue/cards/roguelike worlds (no action authority by source)
NEXUS_REPAIR_OVER_STRONGEST_V1 IDENTICAL to STRONGEST_NATIVE on every world where Nexus changes no action
every episode replays byte-identically (per-step native state hashes)

primaryFamily.population: HOLDOUT, replication A and B separately
primaryFamily.multiplicity: Holm across P1-P3 within each replication; a claim requires the same conclusion in A and B independently
primaryFamily.endpoint: success (native quota met), paired; exact McNemar for superiority; paired bootstrap (B=20000, percentile, seed 0x5eed5eed) for the difference in success rate

decisionRules.QUALIFIED_POSITIVE: Holm-adjusted one-sided superiority in A and in B, point difference >= +0.02, and catastrophe veto not triggered
decisionRules.QUALIFIED_NEGATIVE_NO_MATERIAL_VALUE: strict TOST equivalence within +/-0.05 (two one-sided 0.025 tests) in A and in B; or exact trajectory identity on every valid world in A and B (the expert was invoked on every decision and changed none)
decisionRules.QUALIFIED_NEGATIVE_HARM: Holm-adjusted one-sided inferiority in A and in B, or catastrophe veto triggered in both
decisionRules.INCONCLUSIVE: anything else, including disagreement between A and B; nonsignificance is never equivalence

primaryFamily.decisionCoverage: reported first: fraction of P0 decisions where Nexus changed the action; by observable regime and observable time-remaining band (descriptive)

power.note: worst case (SD of a paired binary difference <= 1). If Nexus rarely changes actions the true SD is far smaller; that cannot be used to shrink N.

secondaryFamilies.S1_STRUCTURAL_OOD: P1-P3 in each of the 4 factory OOD strata; Holm across 12 tests per replication; descriptive unless both replications agree
secondaryFamilies.S2_FACTORY_SECONDARY_METRICS: timeToObjective, finalThroughput, resourceWaste, constraintViolations: paired bootstrap, Holm across metrics; descriptive
secondaryFamilies.S3_CONTROLLER_COMPETENCE: STRONGEST_NATIVE vs RULE_V32, vs UNIFORM_RANDOM, vs FIXED_WAIT per game and tier on HOLDOUT (100 worlds per tier per replication); validates benchmark discrimination; NOT expert evidence
secondaryFamilies.S4_COMPUTE: per-decision latency p50/p95/max and total, and expert calls per decision, per arm; overhead = adapter minus strongest

catastropheVeto.rule: any catastrophe introduced by a Sentinel arm on a world where its comparator had none vetoes QUALIFIED_POSITIVE; additionally the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson upper bound on the introduction rate must be <= 0.02
catastropheVeto.zeroEvents: zero observed introductions establish only the upper bound

invalidAndTimeout.rule: INCOMPLETE_DECISION_BUDGET is a valid outcome scored as non-success; invalid statuses exclude the world from that comparison; invalid rate > 1% in any replication makes that replication INCONCLUSIVE

protocol.stopRules: No interim analysis and no efficacy stopping. Execute the complete A then B schedules once. Abort only on an integrity-control failure (classification CAMPAIGN_INVALID, all results reported). No rerun, retry or seed substitution after any outcome is seen.
protocol.independentReplay: Every episode replayed during the run; after both replications lock, replay a fixed deterministic 5% subset (worlds with seed index % 20 == 7) in a fresh process and compare actionHash/finalStateHash.
protocol.stage3hMapping: See evidence/exit-matrix.json. A positive ASCII result qualifies only the bounded claim named in its hypothesis; it does not complete Forge World qualification, establish canonical MoE gain, or certify Stage 3H.
prohibited: tuning arms after any holdout outcome
